title: 亿纬锂能德国仓库正式开启运营
content:
集邦光储观察获悉，11月5日，亿纬锂能宣布，其德国莱比锡VMI仓库正式揭牌运营。
此前几日，亿纬锂能大洋洲子公司也在澳大利亚墨尔本正式成立。亿纬锂能接连接宣布两项海外布局动态，匹配海外客户交付增长需求。
德国地处欧洲汽车与高端制造产业核心区域，也是亿纬锂能欧洲本地化布局的重点区域。该VMI仓库投运后，将通过前置仓储调整区域库存与配送链路，改善跨境交付周期长、库存调度滞后问题，提升库存周转、供应链可视化以及订单响应速度，为欧洲客户提供就近供应保障。
亿纬锂能表示，将持续深化和DHL等物流服务商的合作，依托其成熟的仓储网络、运力及本土运营能力，完善欧洲仓储网络，增强供应链韧性。
大洋洲市场方面，10月27日，亿纬锂能大洋洲子公司正式成立。揭牌同期，亿纬锂能发布四款储能产品，包括Mr.Big Family系列6.9MWh储能大电池系统、LF702S高能量电芯、“磐盾系列”6C/10C高倍率园区备电柜。
活动现场，亿纬锂能大洋洲子公司与Akaysha Energy、EPEC Group、EWE Group、Hitachi Energy四家企业进行战略合作签约。各方将围绕电网侧长时储能、分布式备电、电网调频、项目开发、技术协同及本地化交付等方向开展深度合作。
海外业务加速推进，也和亿纬锂能当前业务增长节奏相匹配。
在10月23日的投资者电话会议上，亿纬锂能披露，随着国际客户交付规模提升，2027年公司的储能电池海外占比将明显抬升。

title: 林洋能源与LG新能源达成战略合作
content:
11月5日，第九届中国国际进口博览会在国家会展中心（上海）隆重开幕。江苏林洋能源股份有限公司（以下简称"林洋能源"）与LG新能源（中国）有限公司（以下简称"LG新能源"）在展会现场正式签署战略合作协议。南通市市长张彤、副市长李玲；LG新能源全球首席战略官金在权、全球高级副总裁金佑燮、中国区总裁崔智雄、中国区副总裁郑渊斗；林洋集团创始人、总裁陆永华，林洋能源副总裁崔东旭等领导及双方高管团队出席，共同见证这一重要时刻。
根据协议，双方将秉持优势互补、务实协作、合作共赢的原则，围绕储能电站开发、储能系统集成、智慧运维服务等领域建立长期战略合作关系。合作将优先推动南通电网侧独立储能项目落地，同步联合推进南京独立储能项目，逐步将合作版图拓展至全省乃至全球同类项目。其中南京项目涵盖电站开发建设、智慧运维及配套能源服务等多项内容。
本次携手是双方整合优势资源、共建全球储能产业链、共拓全球清洁能源市场的重要举措，为中外企业协同深耕绿色能源产业提供了新示范。对于地方发展，合作项目将服务南京、南通等地绿色低碳部署，赋能城市能源结构转型；对于产业层面，双方发挥互补优势，为国内储能产业国际化发展输出可借鉴的协作模式。本次合作进一步强化了公司项目开发与全球市场开拓的双重实力，为公司储能业务的规模化、全球化发展注入新动能。
下一步，林洋能源与LG新能源将成立专项工作专班，建立高层常态化沟通机制，全力推进示范项目高质量落地，持续拓展合作广度与深度，打造更多可复制、可推广的标杆项目，为全球能源产业高质量发展、构建清洁低碳安全高效的能源体系贡献更大力量。

title: 正力新能与日立（中国）签署战略合作协议
content:
11月5日，江苏正力新能电池技术股份有限公司与日立（中国）有限公司在第九届中国国际进口博览会现场共同签署战略合作框架协议，双方将依托各自产业链核心优势，围绕AI数字化能源、绿色制造、研发品控、全球化市场、标准共建五大方向开展多层次深度协同，携手推动锂电池、新型储能、AIDC能源管理领域的技术创新与全球化落地。常熟市委副书记、市长张伟，日立集团中国总代表汤次善麿，日立（中国）总经理蛎崎忠康，日立（中国）副总经理龙剑，正力新能董事长曹芳，正力新能总裁陈继程，以及常熟市商务局、常熟高新区领导参与签约仪式。
日立集团作为全球综合产业集团，业务覆盖数字系统与服务、能源、轨道交通及产业互联四大领域。其中日立旗下日立能源是英伟达NVIDIA DSX Ready首批三家储能（BESS）认证企业之一，其储能方案适配AI工厂供电架构，在AIDC储能、数据中心备电、电网接入、输配电装备、储能并网、能源管理系统及虚拟电厂领域拥有深厚技术积淀，能够从电网端到用电端为新能源及数据中心客户提供全生命周期解决方案，在全球能源转型与绿色制造领域拥有丰富项目实践经验。
正力新能作为中国领先的电池企业，在动力、储能、AIDC、电动船舶、电动航空、具身智能机器人等领域全面发力，形成了陆海空全领域业务布局，与日立集团在绿色低碳、能效提升与全球化发展等方向高度契合。特别是在具有巨大潜力的AIDC储能领域，正力新能航空级安全产品、高倍率电芯产品、钠电产品、大储电芯产品等，能够满足AIDC白区（机柜级）安全备电毫秒级响应、灰区（机房级）800V高压直流、绿区（园区级）长时储能等全方位需求，与日立集团形成互补，共同在AI数字化及电力与储能系统协同、机房级UPS不间断备电、机柜级BBU电池备份单元方案的联合开发、生产动力系统与绿色制造解决方案、材料研发与制程质控、全球化布局与供应链协同、技术共研与标准共建等领域进行协作，并建立常态化对接机制，持续推进合作落地。
中国国际进口博览会是链接中国新能源制造能力与全球前沿技术资源的重要平台，正力新能也将以此次签约为契机，与日立（中国）在全球新能源产业链深度协同，秉持“优势互补、互利共赢、创新驱动、共同发展”的原则，打通“电芯制造、工厂能源、储能并网、海外落地”的全链路商业落地，面向储能、AIDC、新能源汽车、电动船舶、航空飞行器、具身智能机器人等高速增长赛道输出更安全、高效、低碳的能源解决方案，共同推进全球能源低碳转型。

基于双方的良好互信与合作基础，HANCHU ESS将秉持“被看见、被托付、被成就”的服务理念，与Micmar聚焦本地化生态构建与多维市场开拓，进一步深化本地化布局。双方将实现优势互补与深度协同，共同为赞比亚市场提供可靠、高经济性的储能产品与能源服务，合力推动HANCHU ESS储能业务持续落地，助力当地能源可及性提升。

title: 通威/天合等4企发布光伏订单进展
content:
近期，国内头部光伏企业海内外订单捷报频传，通威、天合光能、晶科能源、上能电气相继发布最新光伏订单进展，涉及国内框采、欧洲、中亚、东南亚等市场。
通威TNC组件入围华电5GW组件框采
11月4日，通威发文宣布，其TNC系列高效组件于近日成功入围中国华电集团2026年第二批光伏组件框架招标项目。
据悉，本次框架招标对产品发电性能、长期运行可靠性、全场景适配能力均有明确要求，这也是通威连续多次入围中国华电集团组件框架采购名单。
天合光能签欧洲580MW大单
11月5日，天合光能宣布与国际可再生能源公司Energix达成合作，将为东欧四座大型地面光伏电站项目提供组件与支架一体化解决方案，规模共计为580MW。
据悉，项目将采用天合光能最新一代至尊3代760W系列组件，搭配自研支架系统，以协同方案简化项目全流程管理。
晶科能源签约吉尔吉斯斯坦光伏项目
11月5日，晶科能源宣布签约已与吉尔吉斯斯坦325MW光伏电站签订供货协议，将供应飞虎3（Tiger Neo 3.0）高效组件。
据悉，该光伏项目将全部采用晶科飞虎3组件，建成后，将成为吉尔吉斯斯坦迄今最大规模的光伏电站。
从市场发展来看，吉尔吉斯斯坦光伏市场尚处起步阶段，大型集中式光伏项目仍较稀缺，325MW集中式地面电站在当地电力市场中具有显着规模效应。
上能电气孟加拉工商业光伏项目落地
11月5日，上能电气宣布，近日为孟加拉国一针织复合材料企业的打造5.124MW工商业光伏项目成功落地。
该项目由Active Renewable Energy担任EPC承包商，整套光伏系统搭载了上能电气125kW工商业光伏逆变器，针对孟加拉国炎热潮湿的气候环境定制适配，保障设备长期稳定运行。

content:
近期，隆基绿能、晶澳科技、晶科能源相继披露2026年第三季度业绩说明会投资者关系活动记录表，围绕BC技术进展、组件出货、经营情况、储能业务及海外市场布局等问题进行了回应。
11月5日，隆基绿能披露2026年第三季度业绩说明会投资者关系活动记录表，介绍了BC组件、ACM技术产业化及储能业务进展。
BC业务方面，2026年前三季度，公司实现组件出货量48.61GW，其中BC组件销量31.64GW，同比增长118.58%，出货占比超过65%，在海外及分布式市场的占比显着提升。公司表示，将根据集中式、分布式市场的不同客户需求，继续拓展BC组件场景化应用及市场份额。
技术方面，公司自研ACM（纳米合金矩阵式接触）技术已实现GW级电池及组件规模化投产，可使BC电池量产转换效率提升0.2%—0.3%，同时提升组件功率及长期可靠性。后续ACM产线建设进度将结合银浆价格变化及下游客户需求等因素综合确定。
储能业务方面，截至目前，公司储能业务订单已超过3GWh，订单转化进度主要取决于下游客户项目并网进度，相关业务与组件业务的协同主要体现在营业收入端。
10月30日，晶科能源披露2026年第三季度业绩情况。受高效组件产品出货增加、产能利用率提升及储能业务发展等因素影响，公司第三季度归母净利润同比、环比均实现减亏。
组件业务方面，第三季度公司组件出货量为15GW，其中飞虎3产品出货量5.6GW，高功率飞虎2产品出货量5.1GW，高效产品出货规模较第二季度翻倍。目前，飞虎3产品占组件出货量的比例约为30%，公司预计明年这一比例将提升至50%以上，进一步改善组件业务盈利水平。
储能业务方面，第三季度公司储能系统确收规模为1.75GWh，首次实现单季度经营性盈利，毛利率达到15%—20%。公司预计，2027年储能业务收入确认规模将增长近100%，并计划将工商业储能业务占比由今年的约5%-10%提升至20%左右，预计储能业务净利润率达到5%-10%。
产品研发方面，晶科能源近日发布基于全新TAC技术的飞虎5组件，推动晶硅电池转换效率突破28%。目前，该产品已在澳大利亚上市，后续计划进入日本和欧洲市场，主要面向高端分布式市场。
此外，晶科能源表示，未来将进一步降低资本开支，采取更加审慎的产能建设策略，同时持续投入前沿技术研发。在经营层面，公司将重点推动高功率产品溢价释放、储能业务规模化发展及降本增效。
10月30日，晶澳科技披露2026年第三季度业绩说明会投资者关系活动记录，对前三季度出货情况、盈利变化及技术和储能业务进展作出说明。
出货方面，2026年前三季度，晶澳科技电池组件出货量达36.22GW（含自用68MW），其中海外组件出货占比约61%。分区域来看，境内出货占比39%，境外出货占比61%，其中欧洲、亚洲及大洋洲、美洲、非洲分别占约23%、22%、8%和7%。
经营业绩方面，受光伏行业产能供需失衡、市场竞争加剧及组件价格持续低位运行影响，公司前三季度仍处于亏损状态。不过，第三季度公司电池组件出货13.97GW，环比提升约35%，带动营收环比增长；同时，公司持续推进降本增效，单位成本有所下降，第三季度毛利率同比、环比均有所改善，亏损幅度较上季度收窄。
技术方面，晶澳科技表示，TOPCon量产效率持续保持全球第一梯队，混合BC电池技术转换效率不断刷新纪录，高功率产品出货占比持续提升。
储能业务则围绕大型储能、工商业储能及户用储能构建产品体系，重点拓展欧洲、中东等市场，报告期内海外项目持续推进。

title: How Do You Land on a Moon With Almost No Gravity?
content:
Japan’s MMX mission aims to sample the Martian moon Phobos
12 min read
Japan's MMX spacecraft will fire its engines to slow down and enter orbit around Mars.
Last August, looking up
Perseverance rover
’s electronic eye spied an oblong shadow crossing the distant, glowing Sun.
, the Martian moon named for the Greek god of fear and panic, was transiting the solar disk. Too small to darken the pale, dust-tinged sky, but orbiting close enough to eclipse a significant fraction of the Sun, Phobos passed in less than a minute.
NASA’s Perseverance rover captured Phobos passing in front of the Sun from the surface of Mars.
ASU/MSSS/SSI/JPL-Caltech/NASA
The tiny moon, with its murky origins, is an enigma, and one whose makeup and history could tell us much about
and the wider solar system. And now the international
Martian Moons eXploration
(MMX) mission, which successfully
launched on 20 October
, seeks to explore that mystery with an unprecedented series of landings on the unknown surface of Phobos.
This mission brings unusual challenges—for example, designing an orbit to study a microgravity moon orbiting a much larger planet. Engineers also had to figure out how to assess and land on this low-gravity pile of loosely assembled dirt and rock, how a rover might rove across it, and how the spacecraft might take samples and return them to Earth.
“I often say that landing on Phobos is like trying to land a balloon,” says
Yasuhiro Kawakatsu
, project manager of MMX at the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (
). “It’s very difficult to drop a balloon to the ground and prevent it from tilting or bouncing.”
Why Phobos Is Such a Strange Moon
Phobos is one of two small Martian moons; the other is
, named after the Greek god of dread and terror. Their cosmic origins are unknown, though there are two prevailing theories. One holds that the moons were once asteroids from the belt between Mars and Jupiter, captured by the smaller planet’s gravity. In the other theory, Phobos and Deimos formed when a large celestial body slammed into Mars, sending debris into orbit. Some models suggest the pair are the last survivors from a cluster of satellites.
The enormous Stickney crater, roughly 9 kilometers across, dominates this view of Phobos taken by NASA’s Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter.
University of Arizona/JPL-Caltech/NASA
Scientifically speaking, Phobos is considered a rubble pile, a loosely consolidated aggregate of rock and dust. Far too small to become spherical under its own mass, it’s shaped like a lumpy potato, roughly 27 kilometers in length, with only 1/1,800
of Earth’s gravity. On Phobos, a typical adult would weigh about as much as a tennis ball does on Earth.
More than 10 years in the making, MMX launched on Japan’s flagship H3 rocket from Tanegashima spaceport on 20 October local time. It will arrive at Mars in 2027 carrying scientific payloads from several space agencies, including
, and a new rover called
developed by the French and German space agencies (CNES and
) in collaboration with JAXA.
Engineers assembled MMX’s modules at Japan’s Tanegashima Space Center before the spacecraft’s October 2026 launch.
MMX consists of three modules: a propulsion module to power its journey to Mars and apply the brakes to enter orbit around the red planet; an exploration module carrying the rover, sampling gear, and other scientific instruments; and a return module, attached to the exploration module, that harbors the capsule destined for a high-speed reentry into Earth’s atmosphere. After collecting samples on Phobos, the exploration and return modules will lift off together. The exploration module will then be jettisoned while the return module sets a course back home.
If all goes according to plan, MMX will deliver a 10-gram sample to Earth in the second half of 2031. But the mission will face a series of daunting challenges to reach that end point, including navigating complex orbits around Phobos and landing on its surface while Mars periodically blocks communications with Earth.
The MMX’s modular design includes the propulsion module [left] and the exploration and return modules [right].
Kyodo News/Getty Images
“It’s the most complex mission I have ever seen,” says
Patrick Michel
, director of research at CNRS (the French National Center for Scientific Research) and co-principal investigator on Idefix.
How MMX Will Orbit Phobos
An H3 rocket carried MMX into space on 20 October 2026, beginning the mission’s five-year journey to Phobos and back.
The Asahi Shimbun/Getty Images
Once MMX reached low Earth orbit, its propulsion module’s engine fired, kicking off a nearly year-long deep-space cruise to Mars. On arrival, the spacecraft will need to fire its engines in an extended, carefully timed burn to slow down enough to be captured by Mars gravity. The propulsion module will then be jettisoned, leaving the exploration and return modules to orbit Mars.
“If something doesn’t go according to plan, MMX will fly by Mars and get catapulted into the solar system,” says
Nicola Baresi
, an astrodynamicist who coauthored
on specially designed orbits for MMX.
Martian Maneuvers
To reach Phobos, MMX will execute three major maneuvers: MOI-1 will put the spacecraft into orbit around Mars, MOI-2 will transfer it toward Phobos, and MOI-3 will place it into its final orbit alongside the moon.
Chris Philpot
The best existing images of Phobos, from spacecraft such as NASA’s
Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
and ESA’s
Mars Express
, have resolutions of only a few meters per pixel. That’s larger than Idefix, the mission’s rover, itself about the size of a microwave oven. To map the surface in greater detail, MMX will loop in front of and behind Phobos at distances ranging from 200 kilometers to less than 20 km from the surface.
During its two-year remote sensing campaign, the exploration module will use several cameras and a laser altimeter to map the surface in high resolution and look for candidate landing sites. When Mars passes behind the Sun as seen from the Earth, causing a roughly two-week communications blackout, MMX will retreat into a larger, stable orbit. After communications resume, MMX will prepare to send its first visitor down to the surface.
Idefix Rover: The First Penguin
Before the exploration and connected return modules attempt to land, Kawakatsu says, MMX will send a scout that in Japanese is called “the first penguin,” leaping into unknown waters. For this mission, the first to leap will be the Idefix rover, named for the canine companion to Obelix in the French comics series
. The exploration module will release the rover during a low-altitude pass of between 40 and 100 meters above Phobos’s surface in 2028 or early 2029.
MMX will use its TENGOO camera [left] and
laser altimeter [right] to map Phobos’s terrain.
It will be a tense moment that calls back to 2005, during Japan’s
Hayabusa mission
to explore the asteroid Itokawa. In a similarly designed drop, the MINERVA rover was released from an orbiter, but erroneously at 200 meters instead of the intended 70 meters. The rover missed the asteroid and, without propulsion, drifted off into deep space.
Idefix will get a slight nudge out of the exploration module toward its negligible-gravity target, freefalling and likely tumbling as it goes. It’s expected to touch down with a velocity of less than 1 meter per second. Unlike
that have landed on other surfaces with airbags or dedicated landing legs, Idefix will land without protection, apart from some extra padding on the solar panels due to their critical nature. The barely-there gravity of Phobos should allow the 23-kilogram rover to land softly, though exactly how this landing will play out is hard to predict.
The Idefix rover will travel to Phobos with its wheels tucked in and solar panels folded.
“It will bounce probably several times,” says
Stephan Ulamec
, Idefix’s co-principal investigator and project manager at DLR. “It will come to rest somehow in some position.” Once it’s still, four retracted legs will deploy to
right the rover autonomously
, regardless of its orientation. It will then unfold its solar panels to charge its batteries for exploration tasks ahead.
A simulation shows how Idefix is expected to tumble onto Phobos, right itself using its articulated legs, and begin exploring the moon’s surface.
Once operational, Idefix will roll at a snail’s pace, topping out at one millimeter per second. Its metal wheels have protruding blades like a paddle wheel, designed to gain traction in Phobos’s microgravity. “If we were to drive our rover faster, then it would actually be more like we were swimming through instead of driving across the surface,” says
Cecily Sunday
, a doctoral student involved in testing Idefix’s WheelCams at the Institut Superieur de l’Aeronautique et de l’Espace (ISAE-Supaéro) in Toulouse, France.
WheelCams
, a pair of cameras placed on the underside of the rover, will observe the wheels and their tracks during Idefix’s planned 100-Earth-day primary mission. The images will help researchers study the size and distribution of grains in Phobos’s regolith and how cohesive they are. How much or how little the grains stick together will greatly impact how Idefix moves. Sunday likens this to the difference between driving on dry and wet sand. “Think of trying to build a sandcastle with dry sand,” she says. “You can’t. Add water, and suddenly you can.”
The Idefix rover was mounted between the MMX spacecraft’s landing legs for the journey to Phobos.
The team tested the rover’s nine-bladed wheels on a variety of materials, including Phobos regolith simulants provided by JAXA and DLR, lunar simulants, glass beads, quartz sand, and clay pebbles. “We characterize the mechanical properties of each simulant precisely, then test across the full range, with varying grain size, angularity, and even color, so we can map what we see in the WheelCam images back to actual surface properties,” Sunday says.
Despite the microgravity and Phobos’s rubble-pile nature, Sunday says Earth-based tests can approximate the rover’s motion on the surface of the small moon fairly well. While Phobos’s reduced gravity lowers the rover’s effective weight, there is also reduced pressure between the grains beneath its wheels. “As long as you’re moving very, very slowly and using the same materials and the same weight of the system, they should be representative,” Sunday says.
With four paddle-like wheels and deployable solar panels, Idefix is designed to crawl across Phobos.
Ardan Fuessmann/Imago/Alamy
Idefix’s interactions with its new home will offer “sub-millimeter resolution and information on porosity, on grain size, on surface strength, on how hard is the material,” Ulamec says. “It fills a gap between remote observations from orbit and detailed observations of the return samples back on Earth.”
What Idefix finds on this rocky, rugged world will help determine how and where JAXA attempts to land the main spacecraft. Michel says the touchdown will provide ground truth for understanding of Phobos. When NASA’s
OSIRIS-REx
spacecraft touched down on the asteroid Bennu to collect a sample, its sampling arm surprisingly sank
nearly half a meter
into the loose material. But Ulamec doesn’t think Idefix will sink deep into Phobos, noting that Bennu is very different and much smaller, with a diameter of 500 meters.
How MMX Will Land and Collect Samples
Once Idefix has investigated the surface, MMX will face an even greater challenge: landing its much larger exploration module on Phobos. The spacecraft will make a controlled descent to roughly 10 meters above the surface, then drop the remaining distance in free fall. With so little gravity to pull it downward, even a small sideways motion could cause the lander to tip or bounce away. A successful, upright landing would mark the start of up to two hours on Phobos for the crucial sampling phase.
The MMX mission draws on the experience and technologies of Japan’s two Hayabusa sample-return missions, which landed on the asteroids Itokawa and
. But this mission has many more moving parts. MMX’s exploration module will use two sampling devices—a coring sampler developed by JAXA and a pneumatic sampler provided by NASA and fabricated by
Honeybee Robotics
, a subsidiary of
Blue Origin
. Data from these tools, and those carried by the Idefix rover, could answer questions about the origin of Phobos and how the Mars system has evolved.
The coring sampler
uses a robot arm and a cylindrical corer designed to reach at least 2 centimeters below the surface. The arm can maneuver to find the best site for digging. “That by itself is a challenge because we’ve never done it,” Michel says. “You never know what can happen at the very sampling site itself, where you might have a boulder and the arm cannot move.”
Probing beneath the top layer will be valuable because solar radiation, galactic
cosmic rays
, and micrometeorites have battered and weathered the surface. The material below should offer a better record of the moon’s origins, and JAXA aims to collect at least 10 grams of it.
MMX will carry both the Idefix rover [bottom] and a robotic coring sampler [top] designed to dig beneath Phobos’s weathered surface.
The pneumatic sampler takes a different approach. Mounted on one of the lander’s legs, it will inject pure, non-reactive nitrogen gas into the surface and capture the grains stirred up. This sample could illuminate the changes Mars and its moons have undergone over time. The dual system also adds redundancy in the face of Phobos’s unknowns. “If the surface of Phobos proves to be very hard, [the coring sampler] may struggle to penetrate the ground. [The pneumatic sampler] would not experience this issue and still be able to gather material,” Kawakatsu says.
One of the most intriguing aspects of MMX is the additional possibility of collecting material from the planet below. It’s likely that Phobos has been peppered by Martian ejecta thrown into space by meteor impacts, so MMX also provides an opportunity to return the first Martian samples to Earth. Michel estimates that the samples could contain “a few hundred grains coming from Mars.” Scientists can distinguish those grains from native Phobos material by analyzing their oxygen isotopes.
That possibility raises a planetary-protection question. A direct Mars sample-return mission would have to follow strict rules to ensure that potentially living biological material from Mars doesn’t contaminate Earth. But those protocols don’t apply to MMX, even if its sample does collect grains of Martian soil.
A panel of experts concluded
that any microbes blasted off Mars wouldn’t survive the violent impact and ejection or the intense radiation exposure on the way to Phobos. This saved MMX from implementing expensive and time-consuming quarantine and containment protocols for the returning sample.
After landing on Phobos, MMX will have roughly two hours to collect samples from the moon’s surface before lifting off again.
During the brief surface operation, the robotic arm will deposit the samples in a storage unit, from which they’ll be transferred into a
aboard the return module and sealed in a vacuum. After that, lift off.
Once back in Mars orbit, the exploration module will resume its observations of Phobos and make several flybys of Mars’s other diminutive moon, Deimos, to gather data on its surface, structure, and composition. In November 2030, during a favorable alignment of Mars and Earth, MMX will begin the homeward leg of its trip. The return module will separate from the exploration module and power the voyage home, its sole objective to bring the dust of Phobos to Earth.
MMX’s sample return capsule will carry material from Phobos through Earth’s atmosphere in 2031.
Finally, in 2031, the 60-centimeter-wide sample capsule will plunge into Earth’s atmosphere at roughly 12 kilometers per second. Assuming it survives the extreme heat of reentry and lands safely in Australia, scientists will begin to tease out clues about Phobos and the early solar system. JAXA’s Institute of Space and Astronautical Science will receive and curate the samples, which will also be shared with mission partners.
“We have macroscale measurements from the spacecraft, microscale measurements with the rover, and then sample analysis,” Michel says. “So we can relate the three kinds of scales together because we have all of them.” The insights gleaned from orbital images, close-up images of the regolith, and the chemical analysis of the samples could have wider implications for our understanding of our solar system.
“MMX is a mission to understand the Mars system and shed light onto how terrestrial planets like the Earth, and maybe Mars, develop a habitable environment,” Kawakatsu says. “We strongly suspect that our terrestrial planet region formed dry, and water and organics were scattered inwards from the icy-rich outer solar system.” Mars, he says, sits at the gateway between the inner and outer solar system, making its moons valuable witnesses to the processes that shaped potentially habitable worlds.

title: Stop Letting Your Hard Work Stay Invisible At Review Time
content:
This article is crossposted from IEEE Spectrum’s careers newsletter. Sign up now to get insider tips, expert advice, and practical strategies, written in partnership with tech career development company Parsity and delivered to your inbox for free!
Hard work rarely speaks for itself.
When I landed my first job as a software engineer, I had a simple plan: Work hard and somebody would notice. Eventually a manager would tap me on the shoulder and hand me a promotion (probably with a nice little speech).
That plan stalled my career for about five years.
I switched jobs twice, kept my head down, read a stack of programming books, and sometimes pulled 12-hour days. I was never promoted. At my third job, out of frustration, I started interviewing at other companies and almost immediately got an offer for a senior engineer role.
So I went back to my job and quit. My team was blindsided. I liked my manager and the people I worked with, and they came back with a counteroffer. Then someone from HR asked me, “Why didn’t you just ask us?”
Honestly, it never occurred to me.
I took the counteroffer and stayed. Three jobs in, I finally got promoted, and all it took was asking (in the most dramatic way possible).
Today, I would take a different approach.
Year-end review discussions are a great time to push for a promotion. But at most companies, raises and promotions are largely settled before the formal review conversation happens. If the year-end review is the first time your manager hears you want a promotion, you’re usually too late.
Now is a great time to start the conversation.
Hard work is invisible by default
Engineers tend to believe good work speaks for itself. It rarely does. Your manager is juggling a team, a roadmap, and their own boss. They see a fraction of what you do, and the work they don’t see might as well not exist when raises get decided.
Perception is reality, so you have to shape it. That means learning to brag a little.
A “brag document” is a running list of what you accomplished, when, and why it mattered. Add to it every two weeks or once a month, and write each entry so your manager’s manager would understand it.
Engineers tend to write things like “migrated the billing service.” A better entry reads “migrated the billing service, which cut failed payments by 30 percent and unblocked the Q3 pricing launch.” If there’s no number, name who benefited and how.
Include the work people forget to count, too: handling incidents, mentoring new hires, interviewing candidates, and writing the docs everyone else relies on. If you helped your team adopt AI tools this year, write that down. (It counts as leadership, whether or not anyone called it that.)
The document does two jobs. It gives you ammunition when you make your case, and it gives your manager something to ctrl + c then ctrl + v when they argue for you in meetings you’ll never attend.
Just ask
Bragging builds the case. Asking forces action.
If your goal is a promotion or a raise, you might ask: “What would it take for me to get to [the next level] in the next year?”
A good manager will give you an outline that can turn into a plan. Push for specifics until you have deliverables you can work toward, then send a short recap email so the plan exists somewhere besides your manager’s memory. (Managers change jobs too.)
When the answer is “no”
Sometimes the answer will still be “not this year,” and the reason may have nothing to do with you.
Budgets get frozen, promotion slots get capped, and decisions get made above your manager’s head where even a manager who wants to help can’t.
Don’t read too much into that. But be honest with yourself, too. Most of the time, a no means there’s something you aren’t doing yet. Find out what it is instead of guessing for five years like I did.
Asking costs you one slightly awkward conversation. Sitting back and waiting to be noticed can cost you years.

Don’t try this at home: To better understand the risk AI slop poses to scientific publishing today, IEEE Spectrum contributor Benjamin Skuse put IEEE’s research integrity checks to the test by submitting two entirely AI-generated papers. “Science has a spam problem. And the spam filter is getting clogged up…”

Policy change doesn’t just come down to paid lobbyists—lawmakers want to hear from working experts, too. One engineer shares what he learned from his first two visits to Capitol Hill.

content:
Buyers of eligible 2027 BMW EVs will get $500 in public charging credits, including $200 for use at the fast-growing IONNA network.

3:31pm ET
Here's a new reason to buy a BMW EV: free charging.
The $500 offer only applies to 2027 model year BMW EVs. Here's how it works.

BMW's latest Neue Klasse EVs push the boundaries of range and charging speed. In short, they're some damn good electric cars. Now there's another reason to buy one: free charging.
on Thursday said it's offering $500 in public charging credits for 2027 electric models. It applies to the

title: China's World-Beating Supercar Just Hit 312 MPH
content:
BYD's Yangwang U9 Xtreme EV has broken its own speed record, cementing its status as the world's fastest production car.
Photo by:
Yangwang
6:58am ET
The Chinese-made Yangwang U9 Xtreme is the first production car in the world to go faster than 500 kph (310 mph).
BYD’s electric hypercar already had several speed records under its belt, and now it has added two more.
The FIA and Guinness World Records made the latest attempt official.
A Chinese EV is officially the fastest production car in the world and the first production car in history to break the 500 kilometers per hour (310 miles per hour) barrier. BYD’s
Yangwang U9 Xtreme
, a two-door electric hypercar, reached 503.17 kph (312.6 mph) on a public road in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, on November 1.
As a reminder,
the U9 Xtreme was already the world’s fastest car
, after it reached 496.22 kph (308.3 mph) back in September 2025, but the Chinese automaker had already
set its sights last year on breaking the 500 kph barrier
—something that no other production car has ever managed.
The latest and most impressive record happened on a roughly 10-kilometer (6.2-mile) stretch of the E11 road in Abu Dhabi’s Al Dhafra Region, which was closed to public traffic. German racing driver Marc Basseng, the same driver who delivered the previous record, was behind the wheel and needed four runs over the course of two days to set the new record.
The first two runs happened on October 31, when the maximum speed was 490 kph (304.4 mph). Engineers made adjustments to the vehicle’s aerodynamics, suspension settings, and tire pressures to improve stability and performance. Then, on the last run of the second day, the Racelogic recorder made the 503.17 kph (312.6 mph) run official.
According to Guinness World Records, the Yangwang U9 Xtreme now holds the records for the highest speed achieved by a production car and an electric production car in a single-direction run.
The FIA also confirmed the achievement on its website
That last part is particularly interesting because the usual way of breaking records involves two separate runs in opposite directions to account for elevation change, wind speed, and any potential breakdown. BYD went for a single run in a single direction, which could make companies like Rimac, Bugatti, and Koenigsegg raise an eyebrow and challenge BYD’s result.
Nevertheless, going over 500 kph in a production car—albeit a limited-production model—is immensely impressive, especially considering that it’s an EV. BYD plans to make just 30 units of the U9 Xtreme, which is the most powerful and fastest version of the U9 supercar. Powered by four electric motors totaling 2,977 horsepower, the Xtreme uses a 1,200-volt lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery pack that can discharge at a 30C rate. A set of semi-slick GitiSport e-GTR2 Pro tires keeps the car on the road and provides stopping power, helped by titanium calipers and carbon-ceramic rotors.

title: Gas Prices Got You Down? This 261-MPG Volkswagen Solves That—For $140,000
content:
Gas Prices Got You Down? This 261-MPG Volkswagen Solves That—For $140,000
Volkswagen built just 250 examples of the wildly efficient XL1. Now, a barely driven example is up for grabs.
- Volkswagen built just 250 examples of the XL1, an ultra-efficient diesel plug-in hybrid that debuted in 2013.
- The futuristic two-seater achieved a remarkable 261 mpg on Europe's test cycle and could travel 31 miles on electricity alone.
- One is now up for auction in the Netherlands, with an estimated value of around $140,000.
In 2013, VW launched one of the most fascinating experiments in fuel efficiency ever made. The Volkswagen XL1 took 12 years to develop and ended up costing a whopping $150,000 at the time. However, as an engineering exercise, it was brilliant. And since VW only made 250, it's even rarer than a Bugatti Veyron from the same era.
If you're looking for an extreme answer to high gas prices, today's your lucky day. There's currently an XL1 in the Netherlands up for auction on Catawiki. The 2016 model up for grabs has just over 1,000 miles on the odometer and is apparently in excellent condition inside and out.
The XL1 project was spearheaded by Ferdinand Piech, VW's top boss at the time. Not known to ever give up on his lofty, ambitious goals, Piech fought for 12 years, and through several iterations, to finally achieve his "one liter" car, something that could burn just one liter of fuel per every 100 km. VW pulled out all the stops to make it extraordinarily efficient; the result was something closer to a supercar than a Toyota Prius.
That teardrop-shaped body is made from carbon fiber, as is its chassis, saving weight. It debuted a full year before BMW's i3, an EV/PHEV which only had a carbon chassis but a plastic body. The car has butterfly doors and two seats that are offset to optimize the car's aerodynamic shape.
Power comes from an 800cc, two-cylinder, turbo-diesel engine behind the driver—this makes it mid-engine, like a supercar—plus a plug-in hybrid system centered around a 5.5 kilowatt-hour battery. The plug-in hybrid powertrain wasn't originally planned, and didn't come about until near the end of its development, so it needed a massive 50-pound removable charging box in the trunk so you could plug it in.
With a funky hybrid powertrain, a curb weight of just 1,852 pounds, and a drag coefficient of just 0.189, the XL1 was capable of an EU-tested 0.9 liters per 100 km, which equates to 261 mpg. It can also travel 31 miles on battery power alone, registering an insane efficiency of 6.2 miles per kWh, about double today's more conventional EVs. VW said at the time of the XL1's launch that it only needed about 8 horsepower to sustain a steady 62 mph.
The main downside is performance: It only makes 68 horsepower, so it takes almost 13 seconds to get to 60 mph.
This specific car up for auction is expected to fetch around $140,000, according to the auction house. So even with its incredible fuel economy and currently outrageous fuel prices, the XL1's financial breakeven point is still a long ways away. Plus, it runs on diesel, which has seen even steeper price spikes than regular gas. A used EV cuts you off from the gas station entirely, and is a better all-around choice of course.
But for someone who wants an amazing piece of automotive history, the XL1 could be worth the price. Plus, it'll sip on fuel like no other for many of your daily errands—and look cool doing it.

title: How Far Can Your EV Go After It Says It’s Empty?
content:
Journalists drove 15 EVs until they stopped. The Tesla Model Y went nearly 19 more miles, while another EV barely made it half a mile.
Photo by:
AUTOBEST
7:05am ET
All 15 EVs kept going after the dash showed empty. They averaged another 10 miles (16 km).
The Leapmotor B10 went farthest at 19.9 miles (32 km), followed by the Tesla Model Y at 19.3 miles (31 km). The Xpeng P7+ stopped after just 0.6 miles (1 km).
A car can show 0% charge while it still predicts some range; 0% and zero miles don't always coincide.
What do you do when your EV’s range prediction shows zero and the nearest charger is still a few miles away? Will you make it? In a Tesla Model Y Long Range, you’d pull in with miles to spare, while in an Xpeng P7+, you’d have been on the phone with roadside assistance, even if the Xpeng goes farther on a full charge.
That’s one of the more revealing findings from
AUTOBEST’s 2026 ECOBEST Challenge
. All 15 EVs that took part in the group test kept moving after their dashboards showed empty, averaging 10 miles (16 km) before they stopped. The
Leapmotor B10
led with 19.9 miles (32 km), about a mile ahead of the
. At the other end, the
barely managed 0.6 miles.
Photo by: AUTOBEST
How They Ran The Cars Down
Car journalists drove these production-spec EVs in convoy near Milan, Italy, on a set route containing a mix of city streets, country roads and highways. A lead car set the pace, and drivers traded cars every 19 miles (30 km) to level out potential differences in driving style.
Only the driver was aboard each car; all vehicles were set to their standard (not Eco) mode, with climate control on and tires set to the recommended pressures. Temperatures ranged from 68–77°F (20–25°C).
The final stretch took place at Quattroruote’s Vairano proving ground. When a car’s dashboard showed either zero remaining range or 0% battery charge, its driver kept going until the car could no longer move under its own power. They measured the distance between those two points to see how far each EV could still go.
They used a
Zeekr 7GT
as a support vehicle to quickly reach drivers whose EVs had stopped. Using its
vehicle-to-load (V2L) function
, it drew electricity from its own battery pack to get the other vehicles moving again, eliminating the need for a dedicated EV road assistance van.
What ‘Empty’ Actually Means
When your EV says it’s empty, it means you’ve used up the range the car promised you. You may still have enough energy to drive a little farther, since all EVs have a buffer. As the state of charge goes down, the voltage in the battery cells also drops. Before it goes too low, which can damage the cells, the car cuts power to the motor.
So, even when an EV shows 0% and can’t move, some charge remains in the pack—the car won’t let it go completely flat.
Zero percent is the car’s estimate of its remaining usable charge. The range estimate approximates how far that energy will take you. Interestingly, those numbers don’t necessarily have to coincide; they can hit zero at different times. For instance, in
one range test
Tesla Model 3
still showed 2 miles (3.2 km) of range when the state of charge dropped to 0%. It went another 31 miles (50 km) after that point.
AUTOBEST published the distance each car covered after zero, but its results table doesn’t give the usable energy remaining at that moment or the speed each car maintained afterward. So we can say the Leapmotor drove 32 times as far as the Xpeng past empty, but that doesn’t mean its battery had 32 times the current reserve.

- BMW Group’s third-quarter EV sales reached 20% globally.
- After throwing plug-in hybrids into the mix, the percentage reaches 27.4%.
- Europe leads the way, with nearly 35% of cars sold in Q3 being EVs.
The BMW Group, which operates the BMW, Mini, and Rolls-Royce car brands, saw 20% of its global vehicle sales in the third quarter represented by all-electric models. Adding plug-in hybrids increases the electrified models’ share to 27.4%, the company said in its latest earnings report.
Despite the promising numbers, the automotive group clearly has a regionalization problem on its hands. Europe is leading the way by a wide margin, with 34.7% of sales represented by EVs and 46.9% by all electrified models.
Meanwhile, over in the United States, just 4.7% of BMW, Mini, and Rolls-Royce models sold were EVs. That’s a huge difference, and it puts the U.S. at the bottom of the BMW Group’s list for electrification. By comparison, Chinese EV sales amounted to 6.5%, while the Asia-Pacific, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa regions totaled 18% EV sales.
The only thing that saves the day for the company’s electrified lineup in the U.S. is plug-in hybrids, which, together with EVs, had an 11.4% share in the third quarter. It’s also worth noting that the new iX3 and i3 models are just starting to trickle down to American dealers, and the U.S. also doesn’t get the electric iX2 and iX2 that Europeans have access to. The updated i7 is also on its way, but that has always been a low-volume car that never made a meaningful impact on the company’s sales reports.
What’s more, even though one in every five BMW Group models was all-electric in Q3, the company’s year-to-date numbers aren’t so promising. Globally, the group sold 314,552 EVs and 131,653 PHEVs from January through September, a 5.1% decrease compared to the same period last year. EVs saw a 2.7% drop, while PHEV sales declined 10.3%.
The only positive number in the company’s electrification Excel sheets has to do with how many EVs were sold in comparison to everything else in the portfolio. In the first three quarters of 2026, the share of EV sales within the BMW Group reached 18.4%, up from last year’s 18%.
Things should improve once the iX3 and i3 are widely available everywhere in the world, but they’re not guaranteed to be a success in the U.S., where policy whiplash has severely slowed the adoption of all-electric vehicles.

title: Tesla Is Killing The Cybertruck To Make Room For More Robotaxis
content:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company will “wind down” production of the controversial pickup in Texas.
Photo by:
InsideEVs
3:00am ET
Tesla will discontinue the Cybertruck next year, after less than four years on the market.
Company CEO Elon Musk confirmed production will “wind down” next year.
After the pickup’s discontinuation, the automaker will use the floor space at its Texas factory to make more Cybercabs.
The controversial
Tesla Cybertruck
electric pickup will be retired next year, CEO Elon Musk
confirmed on X
. The angular truck went on sale at the end of 2023 and instantly became a social statement—for better or worse.
Production of the
Cybertruck
will start winding down next summer at the company’s Texas Gigafactory, and the extra floor space will be used to build more
Cybercabs
The unpainted truck had a short burst in popularity at the beginning of its production run, but interest fizzled, and sales never reached the potential that Musk and Tesla had envisioned back in 2019, when the vehicle was first presented as a concept.
In this year’s third quarter, the Cybertruck amassed 4,323 sales, according to data from Cox Automotive. From January through September, sales totaled 11,586 units. Tesla doesn’t break out individual sales figures for the Cybertruck, but industry estimates put the vehicle’s overall deliveries at roughly 70,000.
Gallery: 2024 Breakthrough Award Nominee: The Tesla Cybertruck
That’s a far cry from the hundreds of thousands of sales recorded every quarter by the Model 3 and Model Y. It’s also another reminder that electric pickups haven’t quite taken off as their manufacturers had hoped, and Tesla is now taking the fall, just like
did with the
F-150 Lightning
, which went the way of the dodo last year after lackluster sales and ballooning costs.
There’s no denying that you either love or hate the Cybertruck, just like there’s no denying that
dared to do things like no other car manufacturer before it. Sure, some might argue that the angular EV looks like an unpolished fridge, but it brought steer-by-wire and a 48-volt low-voltage architecture to the masses. Whether or not they’ll be adopted by other companies is another story, though.
At roughly the same time as Elon Musk’s announcement that Cybertruck production would wind down in the middle of 2027, Tesla stopped taking orders for the entry-level Dual-Motor All-Wheel Drive version of the model, leaving just the Premium and Cyberbeast trims available to order on the automaker’s website.
Additionally, the price of the remaining models has been increased. The Premium AWD model now starts at $92,490, up from $89,990, while the top Cyberbeast now costs $102,490, up from $99,990. The most recent price bumps come after a similar move in August.

title: Tesla Is Now Powering One Of Its Biggest Charging Rivals
content:
Tesla Is Now Powering One Of Its Biggest Charging Rivals
EVgo just opened its first station featuring Tesla Superchargers, with hundreds more stalls on the way.
- EVgo has installed the first Tesla Supercharger stalls on its network at a station in Chicago.
- The charging stations can work with both NACS and CCS-equipped cars via Tesla's Magic Dock connector.
- Within the next two years, EVgo wants to add at least one NACS port to every charging station it built after 2023.
Superchargers aren't just a Tesla thing anymore. Today EVgo announced that it opened its first location powered by Tesla hardware. The 12-stall charging station in Chicago kicks off an expansion that will include hundreds more Supercharger stalls nationwide, EVgo said.
With the shift to the North American Charging Standard (NACS), Tesla has shifted in some aspects toward a brand-agnostic tech provider. The NACS port was once a Tesla exclusive; now it’s the port of choice when it comes to modern EVs. Similarly, Tesla’s V4 Supercharging cabinets are available for purchase and installation by any commercial client. Tesla's V4 Supercharging cabinets are powerful, offering speeds up to 500 kW.
“Deploying our first EVgo Supercharger marks an important milestone in growing our customer base while supporting the EV industry’s transition to NACS,” said EVgo CEO Badar Khan.
The first EVgo location in Chicago has both CCS and NACS ports, thanks to the Magic Dock connector. The first batch of Tesla-powered EVgo stations will be built at grocery stores and shopping outlet centers owned by real estate company Regency Centers. This developer has had a longstanding partnership with EVgo; it already had plans to implement 400 more charging stalls. It says that Illinois is a great place to start its Supercharger push, since EV registrations have grown 60% over the past two years.
One nice bonus for Tesla drivers: EVgo’s Superchargers come up in Tesla’s in-car navigation system. As long as the “third-party charging” box is checked in the Tesla navigation app, users will be able to navigate to and charge just as easily as they would for a normal Tesla Supercharging station.
EVgo’s expansion spans more than just one developer or a handful of NACS ports. The company says it already is on track to hit 500 NACS-enabled charging stations nationwide (not counting the Supercharging network). Within the next two years, it wants all of its existing stations built after 2023 to have at least one NACS plug.
Tesla isn’t the only DC fast-charging company with hardware capable of charging natively via a NACS port. Once the NACS plug shape was officially certified by SAE, charging cabinet manufacturers quickly integrated it into their designs. However, Tesla’s Supercharging cabinets are known for their reliability. Tesla itself claims that uptime is 99%, and the network is known for being one of the best in the business.
In a recent survey of EV drivers, EVgo came in second place in terms of reliability after Tesla. Implementing more Tesla Supercharging cabinets could continue to elevate EVgo's reputation.

title: Tesla's Kickflipping Roadster Looks Like A Great Way To Lose Your Lunch
content:
Tesla's Kickflipping Roadster Looks Like A Great Way To Lose Your Lunch
Watch a POV video of the Roadster doing what it does best.
- Tesla released a new video of its next-gen Roadster.
- The footage is a POV-perspective of the car performing all of its greatest hits.
- If Tesla ever deliveries these, we're hoping that they include some branded barf bags for passengers.
Car companies have spent the last 140 years figuring out how to perfect ground travel. Tesla decided that winning that war was unimaginative at best. And as we've all seen by now, the carmaker instead took its next-gen Roadster to the sky last month to demonstrate what it might look like to own a flying car one day.
But what would it actually be like to drive (fly?) the thing? This week, Tesla released a video showing a first-person camera view of the Roadster executing its rad kick-flip maneuver and other stunts. It does not look pleasant to experience firsthand.
If you watched the Roadster unveiling last month, this all probably looks familiar. It's the same stunts we saw that day, including the upside-down dive off of the half-pipe and the jump-spin over the Tesla Semi. But seeing it from the car's perspective adds a whole new layer to it, and shows this dizzying experience a person would have from the cockpit.
Watching the cold gas thrusters at work up close during the kickflip gives you a sense of how much goes into ensuring that the car stays upright. The car adjusts the volume of nitrogen that it releases in order to prevent car from over-rotating and transferring from a barrel roll to an out-of-control corkscrew. Just one simple nudge and it lands back on all four wheels.
Then there's the nosedive off of the half-pipe. A bit more correcting to keep the roll and yaw in check—but the Roadster does it without a hiccup.
All of these amazing stunts happened without a driver; Tesla put a dummy in the front seat. Many actual human beings might feel dizzy or even sick from these kinds of tricks.
Tesla hasn't published what kind of g-forces the kickflip generates, but watching the onboard footage also makes me wonder what kind of fighter pilot-style harness and big bolsters are needed to keep the driver in-place versus the road-going version of the car. Heck, you might need to be a fighter pilot to endure these maneuvers.
It's really hard not to appreciate how much engineering went into making the demo happen. Sure, it takes hours to fill up the 600-liter ultra-high-pressure composite-overwrapped pressure vessels with 10,000 PSI of nitrogen for just a few seconds of joy. But man, is it cool to watch from just about any perspective.
And while Tesla can't guarantee that the flying version of its car will reach a single driveway (or be road legal, for that matter), it's still a very cool, very over-engineered party trick unlike anything we'll likely see from a car manufacturer again. If you're going to buy one and put it through its paces, though, I'd recommend having a light lunch.

title: This Chinese EV Maker Wants To Put A Foot Bath In The Back Seat Of Your Car. Really
content:
Move over Rolls-Royce, your Lambswool carpets aren't the ultimate in foot comfort anymore.
Photo by:
12:48pm ET
If you've ever been in the back of a
Rolls-Royce,
you'll know just how lovely its rear lambswool carpets are. Their shag is so deep, soft, and luxurious that it's a crime to keep your shoes on back there. While enjoying them, you might think they're the pinnacle of rear seat foot comfort. However, Chinese EV maker Deepal wants to one-up even Rolls-Royce, with an extendable backseat foot bath.
According to Australia's
Which Car?
sub-brand Deepal recently filed a patent for a foot bath that would extend out from under the front seats, so that passengers can literally wash their feet while on the move. Once extended, rear passengers can place their feet in the water, which is presumably heated, and even massage them on rollers at the bottom of the basin. Hopefully, there's a towel rack or cubby back there, otherwise you're taking wet feet out and soaking the carpets, which sounds like a nightmare for interior mold.
Photo by: Changan
What about sloshing? I can't even drive around with a Wawa coffee cup filled near the top or it'll slosh out of the spout onto my center console. So how is a basin of water not going to toss all of its water onto the floor at the first bump or turn? According to
Car Expert
, Deepal's patent claims that the basin can actually block the water from sloshing out. It also has guide holes which let sloshing water recirculate into the bottom, keeping the liquid level low.
There's also a disinfection assembly, to keep the water from being gross, and a quick disconnect to dispose of the water from the vehicle body.
Will this technology ever actually make production? Who knows, as automakers often patent wild ideas just to future-proof their ability to make it one day. But
foot baths are quite popular in China,
so who knows, maybe there's enough demand for this sort of thing. If it never makes production (which seems likely),though, I think some deep carpets and no shoes, Die Hard-style, will do just fine.

title: OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼警示：未来人类可能无法从 AI 手中夺回控制权
content:
IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（IT之家注：Sam Altman）最近出席 Raj Shamani 播客时表示，人工智能可能通过两种方式走向失控：一是人类逐步将控制权交给自主式 AI，二是某个人或实体垄断 AI 技术。
针对第一种情况，奥尔特曼警告称：“AI 会逐渐失去控制，我们可能有意或无意地将控制权交给能力远超人类的系统，最终再也无法夺回。”
第二种情况的风险在于巨头垄断，奥尔特曼解释称：“另一种情况是，某个人、公司或国家相对于其他所有人来说过于强大。让多个不同路线的 AI 实验室相互竞争，比所有人依赖一家企业安全得多。”
这种对过度集权的担忧，解释了马斯克以及 OpenAI 的前高管等知名人士会选择离开，创办与之竞争的公司。奥尔特曼指出：“很多人的思维中都会出现一种想法，那就是他们只相信自己有能力开发这项技术，因为利害关系实在太大了。”
话虽如此，奥尔特曼仍然坚信 AI 将让人类迎来更美好的未来。他特别提到了基础科学研究，认为下一代 AI 模型能让科学持续进步。

title: 中国空间站造出人类已知最冷物质：铷原子云降至 9.7 皮开尔文，逼近绝对零度
content:
IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据新华社今日报道，中国科学院空间应用工程与技术中心依托梦天舱超冷原子物理实验柜，利用全光阱冷却技术，将铷原子云的等效温度降至 9.7 皮开尔文，较室温降低 14 个数量级，并实现持续 7 秒的稳定观测，刷新了人类已知的最低温度纪录。
IT之家注：皮开尔文是极微小的温度单位，1 皮开尔文等于一万亿分之一开尔文（1 pK = 10⁻¹² K），而绝对零度（0 K，约零下 273.15 摄氏度）是热力学所允许的温度下限，只能无限接近而无法达到。
此前的纪录由德国科研团队于 2021 年创造，当时基于原子芯片磁阱方案将铷原子云冷却至 38 皮开尔文，自由膨胀时间约 2 秒。
中国团队的成果将这一数字压低至四分之一左右，观测窗口也延长至 7 秒，为捕捉极低温下的微弱物理信号提供了更充裕的时间。
此次实验在微重力环境下完成，这是突破地面极限的关键。在地面上，重力会使原子云迅速下坠，要维持悬浮就必须施加更强的束缚场，而束缚场本身会引入额外能量，反过来限制温度进一步下探，地面类似实验的稳定观测时间通常仅约 0.05 秒。空间站的微重力条件让原子云得以近乎自由地漂浮，仅需极弱的光学约束即可实现深度冷却。
中国团队选择的技术路线是全光阱冷却，区别于国际同行惯用的原子芯片磁阱方案。全光阱利用聚焦激光束构建势阱，对磁场干扰不敏感，并且适配后续的光晶格实验，扩展能力更强。
实验系统本身是一项高度集成的工程成果。地面实验装置原本占地约 20 立方米、重达 10 吨，科研人员将其压缩至 0.7 立方米、约 500 公斤，装入空间站实验柜中，涉及超高真空获取、高功率光纤激光器、精密光学对准等多环节的技术攻关。二十余束激光需要汇聚到直径仅几十微米的原子云上，对准误差控制在 5 微米以内，约为一根头发丝直径的十分之一，同时满足航天级高集成、低功耗与可靠性要求。该实验柜于 2022 年随梦天舱发射入轨，项目从论证到在轨取得成果历时约 15 年。
在接近绝对零度的条件下，铷原子云进入玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态，原本无序热运动的原子呈现出宏观量子行为。
论文摘要显示，此次制备的凝聚体包含约 2.0×10⁴个原子，等效温度的不确定度范围为 9.7（+3.2/−2.7）皮开尔文，是首次在微重力环境下利用全光阱实现量子简并气体。更低的温度和更长的自由演化时间，为研究极低温量子气体的相变、非平衡动力学与多体关联等基础问题提供了地面难以复现的实验平台，也有助于推动早期宇宙模拟、超轻暗物质探测等前沿方向。
在应用层面，超冷原子可用于研制更高精度的原子干涉仪、量子传感器与空间时频基准，服务于重力场测量、惯性导航及基本物理常数检验。
相关论文《太空中低于 10 皮开尔文的量子气体》今日发表在国际学术期刊《科学》上。《科学》审稿人评价称，这项工作代表了超低温膨胀领域当前的最高水平。

title: 全球超 320 万青少年洞察：2025 年 24.9% 过去一周每天中高强度运动不足 60 分钟
content:
11 月 6 日消息，世界卫生组织本周三（11 月 4 日）发布研究报告，
指出全球约 2.4 亿的 11 至 17 岁青少年在过去一周，每天的中高强度身体活动均不足 60 分钟。
这项发表于《柳叶刀-全球健康》的研究，汇集了 140 个国家和地区的 389 项人群调查，涉及超过 320 万名青少年。受访者平均每周仅有 2.7 天的身体活动达到上述时长，只有 14% 表示一周七天都能达到。
世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示，过去 15 年里，全球在促进青少年身体活动方面几乎没有进展，女孩的处境尤其令人担忧。他强调，改善这一状况不能只靠要求青少年更加努力，还需要让学校、街道和社区成为能够安全、便利开展日常活动的场所。
研究发现，青少年身体活动的性别差距长期存在。28% 的女孩表示，过去一周没有任何一天进行至少 60 分钟的中高强度身体活动，男孩的这一比例为 22%。一周七天都达到上述时长的女孩仅占 11%，男孩为 17%。在几乎所有受调查国家以及世卫组织各区域，女孩的身体活动水平都低于男孩。
世卫组织指出，身体活动不足是心脏病、2 型糖尿病和部分癌症的重要风险因素。帮助青少年尽早养成积极活动的习惯，对保护健康、减轻这些疾病的全球负担至关重要。
而青少年活动不足并非单一原因所致。居住和学习环境、交通方式、公共空间的安全性、步行和骑行条件、活动费用、社会观念，以及日益依赖屏幕的生活方式，都会影响他们参与身体活动的机会。

title: 全球首台 4000 米级浮空风电系统在湖南岳阳完成城市首飞
content:
IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻报道，全球首台 4000 米级浮空风力发电系统今日（11 月 6 日）在湖南岳阳成功试飞，这是 4000 米级浮空风电系统首次在城市场景完成放飞试验。
此次完成放飞验证的 S4000 浮空风力发电系统，长度达到 67 米，宽 40 米、高 23 米，升空海拔可达 4000 米，输出电压覆盖 10 千伏至 35 千伏，设计使用寿命 20 年。
该系统通过充氦浮空平台将轻量化发电模块送至数千米高空，利用高空稳定的风资源持续发电，发出的电再经系留缆绳送回地面。
浮空风力发电系统首席架构设计师顿天瑞介绍，今天更多要测试的是其接网的性能，开着发电机的情况下，是否会对电力和姿态稳定性造成干扰。城市试飞考验的是“能不能安全、可靠地在市民、在人群周边进行飞行”。城市才是耗电的核心区域，最终还是要让这些供电系统，向着人口更密集的区域迈进。
高空风能作为尚未规模开发的新能源“无人区”，具有风速高、风向稳定、风能密度大等优势，蕴藏着巨大潜力。IT之家了解到，目前高空风能发电主要有陆基和空基两种技术路线：
- 陆基把重型发电机留在地面，靠翼伞、浮空器等空中组件牵引缆绳做功；
- 空基则把发电机组随浮空器送上天空，在高空就地发电。
S4000 浮空风力发电系统今年 8 月，在西北某试验基地完成 4000 米全流程验证，验证了高原、强紫外线、大温差条件下的极限适应性。
中国科学院空天信息创新研究院研究员蔡榕介绍，本次城市场景试飞验证了整套浮空系统的可靠性，也验证了在城市周边真实工况下完成工程交付的可能性和完整性，以及现场快速部署的能力，打通了研发、试验、运行的关键链路，为适航取证、场景示范铺路，有力推动高空风力发电装备从技术验证走向产业化落地。

title: 国防部回应“攻击-21”隐身无人机首次在四川舰成功起降：中国军队新域新质作战力量建设取得的重要阶段性成果
content:
IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视军事今日报道，有记者问：据报道，攻击 21 首次在四川舰成功起降。有媒体称这将拓展中国海军远海作战能力，改变西太平洋海上力量对比。请问对此有何评论？
国防部新闻发言人陈曦大校：“攻击-21”隐身无人机首次在四川舰成功起降，是中国军队新域新质作战力量建设取得的重要阶段性成果。我们坚持以作战需求为牵引，紧跟世界军事科技发展，加快武器装备现代化，完全是为了维护国家主权、安全、发展利益。需要强调的是，中国坚持走和平发展道路，一贯奉行防御性国防政策，始终是世界的和平力量、稳定力量、进步力量。
据央视新闻报道，10 月下旬，我国首艘 076 型两栖攻击舰四川舰连续开展海上试验，我军首型舰载察打一体隐身无人机“攻击-21”首次在四川舰成功起降。
据介绍，这是我国两栖攻击舰发展历程上取得的又一次突破，标志着人民海军具备固定翼隐身无人机在大型海上作战平台起降能力。
IT之家注：海军四川舰，舷号 51，是我国自主设计研发建造的 076 型两栖攻击舰首舰，于 2024 年 12 月 27 日下水命名，创新应用了全自动着舰引导系统、新型综合电力系统、电磁弹射和阻拦技术，可搭载固定翼无人机、直升机、两栖装备等。
自 2025 年 11 月首次海试以来，四川舰按计划稳步开展各项海上试验，顺利完成各类装设备调试和整体运行稳定性测试。今年 7 月，四川舰甲板已划线，电弹已就位，阻拦索已安装。
四川舰外观上最引人注目的设计是其独特的双舰岛式上层建筑和全纵通飞行甲板。传统的单舰岛设计在功能划分上存在一定限制，而四川舰采用的双舰岛设计，实现了前舰岛专注于航行指挥和编队协同，后舰岛则专门负责航空管制，包括无人机、直升机及友舰战机的指挥调度。

title: 工信部等六部门：加快推进具身智能、大语言模型、脑机接口、外骨骼等在养老领域应用，鼓励电商平台设立银发消费板块
content:
感谢IT之家网友
11 月 6 日消息，民政部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部、商务部、市场监管总局、全国老龄办日前印发《
关于培育多元场景 促进适老用品产品消费的若干措施
》（下称《措施》）。
《措施》提到，结合居家养老服务，
推动适老化改造、健康管理、智能安防等用品产品进家入户
。有条件的社区养老服务中心、日间照料中心等社区养老服务设施可开设适老用品产品体验、租售网点，结合社区养老服务场景推动适老用品产品应用普及。鼓励养老服务机构发挥老年客群集聚优势，开展适老用品产品试用、展示、租售，推动适老用品产品规模化使用。
引导有条件的老年教育机构、老年助餐点等为老服务设施嵌入式设置适老用品产品消费场景，拓展提供展示租售业务，实现资源共享、服务协同，满足老年人就近就便消费需求。引导各地因地制宜整合利用现有设施培育一批综合为老服务中心（乐龄中心），
设置适老用品产品消费专区，推动适老用品产品消费和老年人文体娱乐、教育培训等服务融合发展
鼓励有条件的地方组织筛选优质企业、社会组织，在社区公共服务设施设置适老用品产品展示场景，利用本地展馆、步行街、文化广场等资源展销优质用品产品。推动一刻钟便民生活圈建设扩围升级，丰富老年人“家门口”的消费场景。
鼓励大型商超、百货商场、商贸流通企业开辟适老用品产品专营区域
。引导连锁药店、社区便利店扩容经营辅助行走产品、适老食品等日常用品产品，增强消费便利度。鼓励有条件的商业综合体、成熟商圈培育打造银发 MALL、银发时尚街区、“银龄乐活空间”等，进行必要的无障碍和适老化改造，打造城市老年友好消费场景。
鼓励电商平台设立银发消费板块，集中展示销售优质适老用品产品
。引导垂直型电商探索开发线上银发商城，简化界面交互、优化操作流程，构建老年人专属购物平台。推动线上线下消费融合发展，通过线下展示、体验与线上销售、亲友代付等相结合的模式，畅通老年人消费渠道。
IT之家注意到，《措施》还提到，以国家重大科技项目为牵引，
加快推进具身智能、大语言模型、脑机接口、外骨骼等前沿技术在养老领域应用
，研发升级老年人失能照护、康复护理、精神陪护等智能设备。鼓励立足各类消费场景，推动智慧健康管理、智能康复评估及治疗等健康管理产品，以及二便护理、康复支持、生活照料等智能养老服务机器人加快落地应用，为老年人提供生活协助、安全防护、健康监测、应急救助等智能照护解决方案。
鼓励针对老年人不同需求，分类设置适老用品产品消费场景，完善展示、体验等功能，提供差异化适老解决方案。
支持利用实景样板间、增强现实（AR）等技术，还原适老生活环境，提供沉浸式、交互式体验
。配置专业工作人员，加强售前指导，为老年人提供需求评估、产品适配等选购建议。健全定期回访、故障响应、维修保养等售后服务保障机制。
推广“以租代售”、“租售结合”等灵活租赁模式，
引导适老家居、康复辅助器具、智慧养老设备等品类开展租赁服务
，降低老年人使用成本。鼓励各地发展租赁产品清洗消毒、检验检测、产品复用等服务，确保产品安全易用。
实施“银发 +”新业态培育行动，促进养老与健康、文化、旅游、体育等产业融合，发展老年人健康管理、教育培训、文娱社交、法律援助等服务，推动各类消费场景成为老年人活动综合体。
推动利用广电网络平台、营业网点、电商平台、短视频等渠道，推送适老用品产品信息、老龄政策资讯、健康养生知识等内容

title: 我国自主四代核电，全球首个商业化高温气冷堆核岛建设全面启动
content:
IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻报道，江苏徐圩核能供热发电厂的高温气冷堆“炽龙一号”核岛建设今日（11 月 6 日）全面启动，这标志着我国自主四代核电技术迈入规模化商业化落地阶段。
高温气冷堆“炽龙一号”是我国自主研发、拥有完全自主知识产权的第四代先进核能技术。它采用球形燃料元件，能耐受 1620 摄氏度高温，即使核电站丧失冷却功能，反应堆也能靠自然散热保持安全。这种“固有安全”的特性，为高温气冷堆的规模化应用打下了基础。
当反应堆运行时，冷却剂氦气可以将核反应产生的热量带出堆芯。由于氦气化学性质稳定、出口温度高，高温气冷堆不仅能发电，还能提供高温工业蒸汽，具有广泛的应用领域。
据中国核工业集团介绍，高温气冷堆是我国完全自主知识产权的先进核能系统，2006 年被确定为十六个国家科技重大专项之一，2008 年 2 月国务院批准其总体实施方案，2012 年 12 月示范工程正式开工。
位于山东威海荣成石岛湾的高温气冷堆核电站示范工程于 2023 年 12 月 6 日投入商业运行，是全球首座投入商业运行的第四代核电站，其设备国产化率达到 93.4%，全厂 1.5 万多台套设备中有 2201 台套为首创、660 台套为全球首创。
此次建设的江苏徐圩核能供热发电厂位于连云港市徐圩新区，是全球首个将第三代核电技术“华龙一号”与第四代高温气冷堆耦合的核能综合利用项目，一期规划建设 2 台“华龙一号”压水堆机组和 1 台高温气冷堆机组，总装机 3076MW，并配套建设蒸汽换热站。
该项目一期工程于 2024 年 8 月获批，2026 年 1 月 16 日 1 号机组核岛开始混凝土浇筑，计划 2030 年首台机组投产、2031 年全部完工。建成后年可供应工业蒸汽 3250 万吨，最大发电量超 115 亿度，每年可减少燃用标准煤 726 万吨、减排二氧化碳 1960 万吨。
在运行模式上，“华龙一号”负责完成首轮能量转换、稳定产出饱和蒸汽，高温气冷堆则对饱和蒸汽进行二次再热，提升蒸汽参数与品质，项目采用“以热定电、热电联供”机制。
技术层面，高温气冷堆以氦气作冷却剂、石墨作慢化剂，采用 TRISO 包覆颗粒球形燃料元件和全陶瓷堆芯结构，一回路冷却剂氦气出口温度可达 750 摄氏度，能够产生 541 摄氏度的过热蒸汽，即使采用传统蒸汽循环方式，发电效率也可达 40% 以上。
其“固有安全”特性源于物理机理：当温度升到约 1600 摄氏度时，链式反应会因多普勒效应等原因基本停止，而这一温度低于燃料本身的耐受能力，因此“堆芯熔毁”在物理上被极大抑制。
第四代核能系统概念由第四代核能系统国际论坛（GIF）于 2002 年从上百种概念中遴选出六种候选堆型，包括钠冷快堆、高温气冷堆、熔盐堆、铅冷快堆、气冷快堆和超临界水冷堆，我国目前在多条路线上并行推进。
在应用领域上，除发电和工业供汽外，高温气冷堆还能产生满足石油精炼、煤化工、稠油热采等需求的高品质蒸汽，并适用于大规模、工业化制取绿氢。随着石岛湾示范工程投入商运，我国高温气冷堆产业链已初步形成，60 万千瓦高温气冷堆技术方案也已形成并完成初步设计。

title: 续航干到 2000km、能量密度是固态 5 倍！锂空气电池离谱了...
content:
10 月 20 号那篇推文，我们IT之家摊牌了，把固态电池的大实话全撂了出来，结果不出所料，评论区分成两派：有人翘首以盼，有人压根不信。
总之，信与不信，2027 年自有答案，就算明年再来一轮“狼来了”，想必还是会有不少人咬着牙等下去。
但是，要是告诉你，电车的“终极电池”实则另有其“电”，你信不？
这么说吧，固态电池固然猛，但本质上还是在现有锂离子电池框架里做升级；而另一个家伙，直接冲着电池能量来源的底层逻辑去。
它究竟是啥来头，有多大本事？小编这就开挖。
其实标题早就剧透了，那家伙叫锂空气电池，业内也将它称呼为锂氧电池，很是离谱：续航直接干到 2000km，能量密度更是固态电池的 5 倍。
相信看到这参数那一刻，有些IT之家家友心里已经嘀咕了：这不会又是块画大饼的“PPT 电池”吧？说实话，量产确实还没影儿，但实验室里已经捣鼓出一定成果了。
传统锂电池大家都熟：摇椅式封闭系统，锂离子在正负极之间来回荡，电极材料是锂离子的“宿主”，反应不碰外部气体。
锂空气电池呢？直接换玩法，核心是“氧”，搞的是开放系统，属于金属-空气电池，充放电靠一个可逆化学转换反应，核心是过氧化锂的生成与分解：2Li + O₂ ⇌ Li₂O₂。
放电时，负极金属锂失去电子变成 Li⁺；正极多孔碳材料从空气中“吸入”氧气，氧气得电子被还原，和迁移过来的 Li⁺ 结合，生成 Li₂O₂ 固体沉积在正极上。化学能就这样变成电能。
充电时反应逆转：外部电压让 Li₂O₂ 分解释放氧气和 Li⁺，氧气回到空气，Li⁺ 返回负极重新沉积为金属锂。能量储存和释放的循环，也就完成了。
最狠的是，正极活性物质氧气来自外部空气，不占电池自身重量，理论能量密度高的关键就在这儿。
锂空气电池这玩意儿的研究，长期进展缓慢，直到最近四五年，才陆续传出点突破的好消息。
真要说锂空气电池啥时候开始被外界盯上，还得是今年 5 月 30 日的 2026 装备强国论坛，中国工程院院士、宁德时代首席科学家吴凯直接放话：锂空气电池，是宁德时代未来的布局方向。
能让“宁王”摆到下一步聚焦的位置上，这牌面不用多说了吧。
锂空气电池的原理，看到这儿大家应该心里有数了。接下来就具体看看参数：它究竟离谱到什么程度，竟然能压过固态电池，成为真正的电车“终极电池”？
就说最狠的：能量密度，固态电池的 5 倍。记住两组数：锂电池理论能量密度约 250 Wh / kg，固态电池约 700 Wh / kg，固态已经是常规锂电池的 3 倍左右。
锂空气电池多少？化学方程式算出约 3500 Wh / kg，固态的 5 倍。
别急，3500 Wh / kg 还不是天花板，按更宏观、更乐观的理论极限算，这玩意儿上限能到 12000 Wh / kg，直接跟汽油掰手腕。
当然了，这个 12000 Wh / kg 属于是面向未来的终极天花板，建立在“如果一切完美，它能到什么程度”的愿景，实现的可能微乎其微。
据悉，有实验室原型已经超过 1200 Wh / kg，距离 3500 还有差距不假，但已经是当前主流锂离子电池的四倍以上，也明显高于固态电池的理论预期。
想必有IT之家家友会好奇：能量密度这么高，到底有啥用？答案就是续航表现。
1200 Wh / kg 能做到单次充电跑 1600 km 以上；要是最终落地能摸到 3500 Wh / kg，续航破 2000 km 基本就是轻轻松松。
单趟 2000km 是什么概念？油车看完沉默，固态电池看完流泪......
看到这儿，估计不少IT之家家友已经迫不及待了，恨不得锂空气电池明天就落地。只是从现实情况来看，至少还得 4 年才能有所眉目，只因前面还有四重难关需要解决。
第一关，体积大。锂空气电池是开放系统，气体扩散层、空气流道，甚至泵或风扇，都得安排上，把氧气送到反应位点。这些体积开销，封闭的锂离子电池和固态电池压根没有。
所以别看在能量密度上吹得猛，体积上并没有对固态形成碾压，做大了甚至可能反过来吃亏。
第二关，副反应。空气里不只有氧气，水分和二氧化碳都会引发严重副反应，毒化电池系统。
实验室里跑的是纯氧条件，真实空气中要稳定工作，难度完全不在一个量级。
第三关，效率低。锂离子电池往返效率通常高于 95%，锂空气电池却低于 70%。
充电时输入的能量，有相当一部分以热能形式浪费了。
最后一关，也是最要命的：循环差。早期锂空气电池循环寿命甚至不足 50 次，后来实验室做到室温下循环 1000 次，但别忘了，那是实验室条件。
同时，锂金属负极在反复充放电中容易生长锂枝晶，可能刺穿隔膜造成短路，带来安全隐患。
对比一下：磷酸铁锂电池循环寿命 3000 次左右，三元锂电池 1500—2000 次。锂空气电池要是只有几百次的水准，跑多了很快就废了。
实际上，容量瓶颈也是长期困扰锂空气电池的问题，但好在两年前，中国科学技术大学特任教授谈鹏团队发现了突破的关键因素。
近年来，研究人员在锂氧气电池的高倍率性能和稳定性方面取得了诸多进展，但实际容量远没有达到理论值，主要原因在于多孔正极内空间利用率不足。
其中，相变、传质及法拉第反应的复杂耦合以及对电极内部精确表征的技术限制，为揭示正极过程、突破容量瓶颈带来挑战。
解决上述问题的关键是建立放电产物过氧化锂微观行为和电化学性能的联系。在此次研究工作中，为了排除溶剂、催化剂等因素对过氧化锂行为的影响，研究人员通过改变锂离子浓度调节初始动力学状态。
研究团队发现，通过改变锂离子浓度，调控传输与成核动力学之间的匹配程度，可以显著提升锂氧气电池的放电容量。
通过可视化电极和跨尺度数学模型，研究团队进一步探究了过氧化锂分布特性。在 0.5 摩尔每升电解液中，过氧化锂颗粒呈现逆氧气梯度分布，标志着成核与传输动力学达到最佳平衡，从而实现最大放电容量。
另外，针对锂空气电池循环差这个命门，有些网友觉得，换电模式或许能绕过去，况且换电阵营也不再是只有蔚来一个玩家：吉利已与蔚来合作，华为、北汽等也纷纷和宁德时代牵手。
怎么说呢，换电模式确实能帮上忙，但帮的不是最要命的那个忙。
锂空气电池循环差，主要不是“使用方式”造成的，而是材料体系在当前阶段还做不到足够可逆；把一块循环 200 次的锂空气电池拿去养护，它并不会因此变成一块能循环 2000 次的电池。
换电模式能做的，无非是把“一块电池用到底”变成“一个电池池子轮换养护”，治标不治本，它改变的是电池“怎么被使用和轮换”，能解决用户的寿命焦虑，但对电池的核心障碍束手无策，改变不了电池“内部正在发生什么”。
总之，现实点看，锂空气电池的商业化，得等到 2030 年之后才会迎来真正的拐点。
关于锂空气电池的来头，IT之家小编就挖到这里。参数确实离谱，期待值也拉满了。
这里得强调一句：固态电池和锂空气电池，不是谁取代谁的“演变关系”，而是两条路线，固态电池改的是电解质形态，锂空气电池改的是正极反应体系。
固态也好，锂空气也罢，技术这玩意儿，永远有下一手，好东西永远在后头。

title: Metall gezielt verstärken: Winzige Atomschichten bremsen Verformung
content:
Metall gezielt verstärken: Winzige Atomschichten bremsen Verformung
FAU-Forschende machen Metalllegierungen widerstandsfähiger
Hitze und Dauerbelastung verkürzen die Lebensdauer eines Metallbauteils. Ein internationales Forschungsteam, an dem auch Forschende der Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU) mitgewirkt haben, zeigt in einer neuen Studie, wie sich dieser Prozess bremsen lässt. Mit gezielt erzeugten und dünnen Atomschichten machen die Forschende Legierungen widerstandsfähiger. Die Arbeit ist in der Fachzeitschrift Science veröffentlicht worden.
Feste Metalle können unter Hitze und anhaltender Last ihre Form verändern, beispielsweise bei Flugzeugturbinen, in Kraftwerken oder chemischen Anlagen. Dieser Vorgang heißt Kriechen und begrenzt die Lebensdauer eines Bauteils. Ein internationales Forschungsteam unter Beteiligung der FAU und der Ohio State University aus den USA hat einen neuen Ansatz entwickelt mit dem sich Werkstoffe auf atomarer Ebene so gestalten lassen, dass sie dieser Verformung länger standhalten.
An der FAU beteiligt sind Dr. Andreas Bezold, Manuel Köbrich, Jan Vollhüter, Lukas Amon, Prof. Dr. Mathias Göken und Dr. Steffen Neumeier vom Lehrstuhl für Allgemeine Werkstoffeigenschaften. Zusammen mit Nicolas Karpstein und Prof. Dr. Erdmann Spiecker vom Lehrstuhl für Mikro- und Nanostrukturforschung und dem Center for Nanoanalysis and Electron Microscopy untersuchten sie, wie sich widerstandsfähige Strukturen erzeugen lassen.
Winzige Strukturen bremsen Verformungen im Metall
Die Forschenden erzeugten dichte Netzwerke geordneter Schichten, die aus dünnen Atomlagen bestehen. Ähnliche Strukturen können entstehen, wenn sich eine Legierung während ihres Einsatzes verformt. Die Forschenden haben ein Verfahren entwickelt, mit dem sich diese Verformungen bereits vorher herstellen lassen. Ihre festigkeitssteigernde Wirkung kann damit von Anfang an in die Werkstoffentwicklung einbezogen werden.
Anschließend werden die Metalllegierungen mit Wärme behandelt. Hier verteilen sich bereits vorhandene Legierungselemente neu und bilden geordnete Strukturen entlang der atomar dicken Defekte. Dies führt zu einer Änderung der inneren Struktur, die mit einer Steigerung der Festigkeit einhergeht, da die neuen Schichten als Barrieren wirken und damit weitere Verformungen erschweren.
Legierungen im Test: Was Atome über die Festigkeit verraten
Mithilfe von Elektronenmikroskopie und Simulationen konnte das Team zeigen, wie die Anordnung der Atome innerhalb der Schichten zu verbesserten Metall-Eigenschaften beiträgt. Messungen bestätigen diese Ergebnisse: Bei 750 Grad Celsius verformte sich die Superlegierung zudem weniger stark als die Referenzlegierung ohne diese Strukturen. Derartigen Temperaturen müssen die Legierungen zum Beispiel in der Raumfahrt, in Gaskraftwerken oder chemischen Anlagen Stand halten.
Nachhaltigere Werkstoffe
Mögliche Einsatzgebiete für die neuartigen Legierungen sind beispielsweise Turbinen. Langfristig wollen die Forschende untersuchen, ob einfachere Legierungszusammensetzungen vergleichbare mechanische Eigenschaften erreichen. Gelingt das, sind sie deutlich ressourcenschonender.

Wie können kleine Obstbrennereien ihren Energieverbrauch senken? Mit dieser Frage hat sich Ibrahim Abu Mustafa für seine Masterarbeit im Studiengang Process Engineering and Energy Technology (PEET) an der Hochschule Bremerhaven beschäftigt. Seine Ergebnisse zeigen: Die richtige Dämmung würde sich nach wenigen Jahren nicht nur ökologisch, sondern auch wirtschaftlich lohnen.
Der Energieverbrauch einer Obstbrennerei ist im Vergleich zu anderen Getränkeherstellern pro Liter Endprodukt sehr hoch. Dies ist besonders auf die Destillation zurückzuführen, bei der die Obstmaische erhitzt und der entstehende Dampf anschließend wieder verflüssigt wird. Dabei bleibt nicht nur die Abwärme ungenutzt, sondern es wird auch viel Wärme über den Kessel abgegeben. Dass es dafür eine bessere Lösung geben muss, hat sich Masterstudent Ibrahim Abu Mustafa überlegt. Für seine Abschlussarbeit im Studiengang Process Engineering and Energy Technology (PEET) untersuchte er für die Staatliche Lehr- und Versuchsanstalt für Wein- und Obstbau Weinsberg eine 400-Liter-Brennanlage für Obstmaische. Dabei ging es nicht nur um die Frage, ob die Senkung des Energieverbrauchs grundsätzlich möglich ist, sondern auch um die Wirtschaftlichkeit.
Für seine Forschung untersuchte Ibrahim Abu Mustafa zunächst, ob die Wärmeabgabe der Brennanlage durch Dämmung reduziert werden könnte. Hierfür simulierte er am Computer den Wärmeverlust im isolierten und nicht isolierten Zustand. Die Ergebnisse zeigen: Die Dämmung der heißen Kessel- und Anlagenteile kann die Wärmeverluste an den untersuchten Oberflächen um 87 bis 94 Prozent reduzieren. „Bei 134 Brennansätzen pro Jahr ergibt sich für die untersuchte Brennanlage eine Einsparung von rund 823 bis 1.944 kWh Wärme jährlich bei vergleichsweise geringen Investitionskosten. Investiert ein Unternehmen also 1.000 Euro in eine entsprechende Umrüstung der Anlage, würde sich dies auch schnell wirtschaftlich bemerkbar machen. Die geschätzte Amortisationszeit liegt unter den getroffenen Modellannahmen bei einem Strompreis von 0,16 bis 0,20 Euro pro Kilowattstunde zwischen 2,6 und 7,6 Jahren“, so Abu Mustafa. Pauschal auf andere Energiepreise und Wärmeversorgungen lasse sich dies nicht übertragen.
Als weiteren Forschungsschritt widmete sich Ibrahim Abu Mustafa der Abwärme des Kühlwassers, das während der Destillation abgeführt wird. Der Absolvent analysierte zwei Arten von Wärmepumpen, um herauszufinden, ob ihr Einsatz eine sinnvolle Lösung zur Energieeinsparung wäre. Dabei fand er heraus, dass eine Niedertemperatur-Wärmepumpe die Wärme für Warmwasser nutzen und zugleich das Kühlwasser für den nächsten Brennansatz zurückkühlen könnte. In der Simulation lieferte das ausgewählte Szenario 32,09 kW Nutzwärme bei einer Heiz-Leistungszahl von 2,89. Damit ist der ökonomische Nutzen hier nicht so eindeutig. „Die Wirtschaftlichkeit hängt stark davon ab, ob Warmwasser und zurückgekühltes Wasser tatsächlich vor Ort verwendet werden können“, erklärt der Absolvent. Eine Hochtemperatur-Wärmepumpe, die Kühlwasserwärme direkt für den Heizkreis der Brennerei auf über 100 °C anheben soll, sei technisch ebenfalls grundsätzlich machbar. Wegen der hohen Investitionskosten und der geringen jährlichen Betriebszeit von rund 267 Stunden ist sie unter den untersuchten Bedingungen derzeit jedoch wirtschaftlich nicht attraktiv.
Als dritte Möglichkeit könnte auch die Maische mit Rückgewinnungswärme vorgewärmt werden. Die untersuchte Variante mit einem Rohrwärmeübertrager würde Ibrahim Abu Mustafa jedoch nicht empfehlen. „Bei dieser Methode gibt es größere Verschmutzungsrisiken. Außerdem sind die Wärmeübergangswerte eher unsicher und die Wirtschaftlichkeit begrenzt.“ Der Absolvent empfiehlt Brennereien auf Grundlage seiner Ergebnisse zunächst die Dämmung der Anlage, da sich dies auch bei vergleichsweise geringer Betriebszeit schnell wirtschaftlich lohnt. Größere Investitionen, beispielsweise die Installation einer Wärmepumpe, können einen ökologischen Nutzen haben, rentieren sich aber finanziell nur dann, wenn die Anlage viel genutzt wird.
Für die Betreuung und Unterstützung dankt Abu Mustafa Prof. Dr.-Ing. Carsten Fichter und der Hochschule Bremerhaven, Dirk Hofmann von der LVWO Weinsberg sowie dem Anlagenhersteller Arnold Holstein.
Im internationalen, englischsprachigen Masterstudiengang Process Engineering and Energy Technology werden aktuelle Themen der Verfahrenstechnik tiefergehend vermittelt. Dabei geht es um die Untersuchung und Entwicklung technischer Verfahren, die Stoffe nach ihrer Art, ihren Eigenschaften und ihrer Zusammensetzung auf chemischem, physikalischem oder biologischem Wege zu gebrauchsfähigen Zwischen- oder Endprodukten umwandelt. Hierzu gehören auch die Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Fertigung und Wartung der dazu erforderlichen Apparate und Anlagen sowie deren optimaler Betrieb. Die wirtschaftliche und ökologische Nachhaltigkeit sind von entscheidender Bedeutung. So ist die Verfahrenstechnik auch für die Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Klima- und Umweltschutzes sowie der Material- und Energieeffizienz unentbehrlich.

title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
content:
I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
The startup Tau Robotics is sending humanoid robots to clean San Francisco homes. They still need lots of human guidance, but they’re learning.
I’m not the sort of person who typically pays for a house cleaner. I’m too frugal, and I kind of enjoy putting on a podcast and going to town on my tub with a Magic Eraser. But when I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service in San Francisco, I immediately signed up for the waitlist. I wanted my apartment to feel like The Jetsons, even if just for an hour.
I was also motivated by journalistic interest. In order to ensure an authentic experience, I didn’t tell Tau Robotics, the startup behind the X post, that I was a journalist—though I did use my real name, so it’s possible someone looked me up. Tau’s long-term goal is to make autonomous cleaning robots a reality, but they’re not quite there yet: For now, the robots are piloted remotely by humans, who watch what’s going on via cameras mounted in the robots’ heads and wrists. As the robots clean, they collect data that Tau will use to train up their more independent descendants. Every counter successfully wiped and T-shirt successfully folded will help the models that power the robots learn to do better on the next go-round.
Because this data is so valuable to Tau, the company charges less for cleaning than one might expect for such a cutting-edge product. At the time I booked, Tau was offering $30 for an hourlong cleaning with a single robot; now the charge is $60 per weekly cleaning with two robots, or $100 for a one-time visit. But even at the cheaper rate of $30 per hour, Tau’s robots aren’t a great bargain. They are thorough but slow, so if you, like me, are tempted to stand around watching them for their entire visit, it would probably be a better use of your time to just take care of the cleaning yourself.
But the robots are physically capable of cleaning, and they’re undeniably cute. Tau has armed each four-and-a-half-foot-tall robot with a 3D-printed “head” with antennae that allow it to communicate with Tau’s headquarters, as well as two 3D-printed claw “hands” (the more humanlike alternatives apparently aren’t durable enough, and claws do surprisingly well for most cleaning tasks). Mine was wearing a Tau Robotics shirt, and grippy socks so that it didn’t scratch hardwood floors.
With all the human support they need, the robots are closer to radio-controlled cars than Waymos. Many tasks, such as making the bed and folding laundry, require what’s called kinematic guidance: The human pilot performs the necessary motions, and sensors transmit those movements to the robot, which copies them. These kinematically guided tasks produce especially valuable training data. Tau’s AI models might not have solved laundry folding yet, but learning from the examples of robots that have completed the task in the real world is how they’ll get there.
But according to Tau cofounder Cornelia Weinzierl, to whom I came clean as a journalist a few weeks after the cleaning, the robot can already complete some other tasks—such as vacuuming and mopping—without any human help. If Tau succeeds in using all the data it is collecting to train truly autonomous cleaning robots, they could even become San Francisco’s newest tech tourist attraction as Waymos become more commonplace countrywide.
The cleaning robot that came to my building last month was already a bit of a spectacle. It arrived in a blue minivan, out of which it was helped by Weinzierl and another Tau employee. That’s when the robot encountered its first obstacle: the eight stairs leading up to the building’s front door. I’d come down to greet Weinzierl and the robot, so I had a front-row seat to its struggles with my steps. It climbed as if it were drunk. Each successful step was as likely as not to be followed by a stumbling backward stagger that erased all its progress—though, impressively, it never entirely lost its footing.
When I later discussed my experience with Weinzierl, she explained that the robot sometimes walks strangely because it is operated remotely from Tau’s headquarters, and the short signal transmission delay can affect its coordination. “The amount of work and time that we spend just optimizing, for example, timings and connectivity is crazy,” she said.
Inside, the carpeted staircase leading up to my apartment defeated the robot entirely, and Weinzierl had to lug it up the last few steps. This, it turned out, was not typical. As the robot cleaned, it repeatedly stalled out, something Weinzierl attributed to it overheating in the unseasonably hot weather—until she heard from one of her colleagues that the heat had shut down not the robot but the equipment that its human controller was using to watch its progress through my apartment. Without remote assistance, the robot couldn’t clean, and so it, and Weinzierl, departed before my booked hour was up. (Back in September, Weinzierl or another Tau representative remained with the robot throughout its visit, but she says that’s no longer necessary.)
You can’t fault Tau on customer service, though. Weinzierl quickly emailed me to apologize, comp the visit, and offer me another on the house (minus whatever price I assign to my data privacy)—and that was all before I told her I was a journalist. I scheduled the next cleaning for about a month later, after a couple of trips out of town, and it went much more smoothly—the robot got up my stairs without much assistance, though still with the drunken stagger.
In the hour it was there, it did a creditable job of cleaning my kitchen (though it didn’t brave the stove) and even saved me my most dreaded cleaning task, the toilet. That was its most impressive performance: Three times the head fell off its toilet cleaning wand, and three times it managed to reattach it by poking around with the handle until it made contact at just the right angle.
The robot is still rough around the edges, which is to be expected for a product in beta. It repeatedly left my taps dripping, it knocked over a (closed) bottle of olive oil, and it couldn’t manage to right an air purifier that it had toppled. But I easily forgave all those missteps because of how charming it was. As I watched it wipe down my countertops, I felt the same fond gratitude that I feel when a Waymo delivers me safely home after a night out.
Still, it’s not all slapstick and whimsy. If Tau Robotics or its competitors succeeds in training robots to clean autonomously and inexpensively, people could lose their livelihoods, and the United States is a long way away from implementing policies to take care of those left unemployed by AI.
But Weinzierl maintains that someday turning over cleaning work to robots could make a lot of sense. “Cleaning is not a job that a lot of people really actively want to be doing—there’s high turnover, there’s a high risk of injury,” she said when we spoke after the cleanings. “We need people, and we don’t have them, and no one wants to do it.” She said that the company is also starting to consider someday deploying the robots for other dangerous or physically challenging jobs, such as mold remediation and home health care.
Tau Robotics still has a long way to go: The amount of data needed to train robots to do the varied and complicated tasks of apartment cleaning is probably enormous, and the company has completed only a couple hundred cleanings so far. But it’s remarkable that there are now humanoid robots able to clean your toilets and mop your floors, even if they need quite a bit of human help to do so. The Jetsons no longer feels quite so far away.

title: 【NE快讯】纳芯微推出面向线控转向与制动的NSD366x-Q1系列；搭载芯粤能第二代1400V碳化硅主驱芯片的电驱总成批量下线
content:
01. 芯微推出面向线控转向与制动的车规级三相浮动栅极驱动器系列
近日，纳芯微推出车规级三相浮动栅极驱动NSD366x-Q1系列，包括NSD3661-Q1与NSD3662-Q1两款产品。该系列集成三路浮动栅极驱动，面向N沟道MOSFET，支持4.5V至50V宽范围输入电压与0%至100%占空比驱动，内置带扩频调制的两级电荷泵，适用于电动助力转向（EPS）、线控制动系统的相关断（相位隔离）应用，也可用于三相固态继电器、三相高低边MOSFET驱动等场景。
纳芯微NSD366x-Q1系列单芯片集成三路浮动栅极驱动，内置电荷泵，可产生高于电源电压的稳定栅极驱动电压，直接驱动N沟道关断MOSFET，无需为每相单独配置驱动电路，即可实现三相MOSFET的独立驱动，显著简化相关断电路的结构与布局，助力系统以更低成本满足功能安全要求。
纳芯微车规级三相浮动栅极驱动器NSD366x-Q1系列现已全面量产，该系列产品采用5.0mm×4.4mm的带散热焊盘的HTSSOP16封装，全系产品通过AEC-Q100 Grade 1认证。NSD3661-Q1支持4.5V至50V宽压输入，可实现全工况下的稳定驱动。面向功能安全应用，NSD366x-Q1系列内置多层次监测与保护机制。
02. 章鱼能源、新能安与宁德时代签署MOU
近日，英国最大能源公司章鱼能源(Octopus Energy)、新能安与宁德时代签署战略合作备忘录(MoU)。三方将共同探索面向欧洲市场的智能家用储能解决方案。这是继今年6月欧洲重卡换电合作后，章鱼能源与宁德时代在家庭能源场景的延伸。
依托宁德时代的技术与供应链协同，新能安负责电芯、BMS及储能系统的研发制造。章鱼能源依托欧洲终端渠道，导入智能动态电价算法与虚拟电厂(VPP)接入服务，三方优先布局英国、法国、西班牙等市场。
以智能家储为核心，合作贯通屋顶光伏、智能充电、车到网(V2G)及虚拟电厂等领域，把家庭储能资产转化为可智能调度的电网节点，降低家庭用电成本，同时提升欧洲电网的灵活性与韧性。
03. 搭载芯粤能第二代1400V碳化硅主驱芯片的电驱总成批量下线
近日，搭载芯粤能、芯聚能第二代1400V碳化硅（SiC）MOSFET主驱芯片和配套功率模块的高压电驱总成，在国内头部三电系统企业——星驱科技实现批量下线。此次批量生产表明，相关产品已完成客户选型、验证及量产导入流程，进入常态化供应阶段。
这一进展建立在“研发一代、量产一代、预研N代”的持续滚动开发基础上，通过芯片、模块与电驱系统提前协同开发，使芯片设计、晶圆制造、模块封装和整车验证能够同步推进，有助于缩短开发周期、提升产品一致性，并更快响应客户平台需求。
常态化供应，体现了客户对产品性能、一致性和交付能力的持续认可，也对产品在长期批量交付中的稳定性、可靠性和供应保障提出了更高要求。
该第二代1400V碳化硅主驱芯片为面向900V及以上高压平台的正向研发产品，在比导通电阻、开关损耗、抗串扰能力和长期可靠性等方面实现优化，性能指标已跻身国际领先水平。

11月3日，深圳市现代农业装备研究院、贵州星光现代农业装备有限公司与深圳市比亚迪锂电池有限公司在深圳坪山比亚迪总部签署战略合作协议。
广东省现代农业装备研究院党委书记、院长兼深圳市现代农业装备研究院理事长彭彬，星光农机股份有限公司总经理助理郑斌，比亚迪电池副总经理赵彤等出席仪式；广东省现代农业装备研究院党委副书记、副院长兼深圳市现代农业装备研究院院长孟祥宝、贵州星光现代农业装备有限公司执行董事兼总经理童斌、比亚迪电池新甘青宁藏省总张学峰分别代表三方签约。
洽谈中，三方共同分析了行业痛点、市场背景与后续合作方向。当前全球农机市场体量约2000亿美元，中国市场约400亿美元的规模，农机保有量巨大；国家政策明确支持农机行业向绿色化、智能化方向转型。与此同时，农机电动化仍面临电池成本过高、农闲时期设备闲置两大核心挑战，产业经济性有待通过新模式破解。三方合作旨在推进农机电动化，既降低农民柴油使用成本，也助力行业与国家实现降碳减排目标。
合作聚焦四个方面：技术研发上，围绕农机电池应用、农业储能与充电补能开展联合攻关，并在农机专用电池开发中应用复合集流体技术，进一步降低热失控风险，实现高能量密度与高安全性；成果转化上，联合申报省部级课题与搭建产业化验证测试平台，组建创新联合体开展场景验证示范，并推进深喀产业协作；人才培养上，三方共同致力于农机电动化、智能化等方面技术人才的培养，同时开放农业场景课题并提供挂职锻炼机会；产品与材料上，联合研发适配海洋牧场海鲜特种运输的新能源物流车及农用商用车，并探索比亚迪电池新材料在农机设计、研发、生产环节的应用。
三方优势互补、协同发力，着力布局农机领域，打通电池研发、电控匹配、场景验证与运营复用全链条，提升农机电动化的经济性与可行性，为农业装备绿色智能化转型、农业农村现代化及行业降碳减排提供可复制、可推广的合作模式。

title: 亿纬锂能德国 VMI 仓库正式投运，持续升级欧洲本地化供应链体系
content:
近日，亿纬锂能德国莱比锡 VMI 仓库正式揭牌运营。亿纬锂能物流部总经理孔杰、欧洲区质量中心总监吴华武、莱比锡仓库经理陈春衡出席启用仪式，宝马采购部核心负责人 Maximilian Wölfel、Bernhard Böller 及 DHL 管理层受邀到场见证，共同开启多方欧洲供应链深度协同的新阶段。
德国是欧洲高端汽车工业与先进制造业的核心枢纽，也是亿纬锂能深耕欧洲、推进本地化布局的关键阵地。该仓库投运后，将通过前置仓储布局优化区域库存管理模式与物流配送链路，精准匹配欧洲终端客户需求，提升库存周转效率、供应链可视化水平与订单响应速度，有效破解跨境交付周期长、库存调度滞后等痛点，为欧洲客户提供更灵活、稳定、高效的全链条供应保障，持续升级客户交付体验。
此次 VMI 仓库落地，是亿纬锂能携手欧洲合作伙伴，共建本地化供应链生态的重要里程碑。公司将持续深化与 DHL 等全球头部物流服务商的战略合作，依托其成熟的仓储网络、运力资源与本地化运营经验，完善欧洲仓储物流服务布局；通过多方协同强化供应链韧性与运转效能，构建稳定、智能、高效的本地化供应体系，为欧洲业务稳健运营与规模化服务筑牢坚实支撑。
